title: A Fast, Programmable GPU-to-CPU Invocation Layer for GPU-Initiated Communication
abstract: arXiv:2611.23848v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern GPU workloads increasingly rely on device-initiated communication to let GPU kernels communicate directly without synchronizing with the host at kernel boundaries. Existing libraries commonly favor placing transport control on GPU threads, an approach known as GPUDirect Async (GDA), and treat reverse offload to host proxy threads as a slower fallback. We argue that reverse offload can outperform GDA and should be a first-class communication path. We further propose exposing reverse offload as a programming interface that lets users define workload-specific communication operations.   We present KIWI, a programmable reverse-offload framework that achieves sub-microsecond one-way device-to-host latency and hundreds of millions of operations per second. translated_title: 一种用于GPU发起通信的快速、可编程的GPU到CPU调用层
translated_abstract: 现代GPU工作负载越来越多地依赖设备发起的通信，使GPU内核能够直接进行通信，而无需在内核边界与主机同步。现有库通常倾向于将传输控制放在GPU线程上，这种方法被称为GPUDirect Async（GDA），而将反向卸载到主机代理线程视为较慢的备用方案。我们认为反向卸载可以优于GDA，并应成为一等通信路径。我们进一步提出将反向卸载暴露为一种编程接口，允许用户定义特定于工作负载的通信操作。我们提出了KIWI，一个可编程的反向卸载框架，实现了亚微秒级的单向设备到主机延迟和每秒数亿次操作。我们解决了扩展反向卸载面临的实际挑战，包括共享队列上的争用、轮询开销以及代理之间的负载不均衡。KIWI-P2P是一个类SHMEM的库
tldr: 提出KIWI框架，将GPU到CPU的反向卸载打造为一等通信路径，实现亚微秒级设备到主机延迟和每秒数亿次操作，性能可超越GPUDirect Async。
en_tdlr: KIWI is a programmable GPU-to-CPU reverse-offload framework that elevates reverse offload to a first-class communication path, achieving sub-microsecond device-to-host latency and hundreds of millions of operations per second, outperforming GPUDirect Async.
